source_caption:
He's not making that up. 

The Film titled Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother comes from the famous Hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari (5971) and Sahih Muslim, where the Prophet Muhammad emphasized the supreme duty of honoring and caring for one's mother three times before naming the father on the fourth time.

The film inspired by Bassam Tariq's real-life experience is Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother (2026). Written and directed by Tariq, the thriller stars Mahershala Ali as a devout Muslim hitman and widowed father searching for breast milk for his newborn daughter while navigating dangerous encounters across Houston.

source_details.synopsis: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother is a 2026 American action thriller film written and directed by Bassam Tariq, starring Mahershala Ali, John Cho, Giancarlo Esposito, Abubakr Ali, Tramell Tillman, Tiffany Boone, and Laith Nakli. The film premiered at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival, and had a limited theatrical release in the United States by Amazon MGM Studios on September 25, 2026. It received widespread praise from critics.
